'''F-29-PSKx''', also known simply as '''F-29''', was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]]<ref name="Star Tours" /> [[F series repair droid]]<ref name="Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours" /> with [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] and silver plating, with a blue trim.<ref name="Star Tours" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]],<ref name="KOTHB">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> he worked for the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency.<ref name="CSWE" /> While visiting its [[Tomorrowland Starport]],<ref name="Complete Guide to Star Tours">''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]''</ref> F-29 felt homesick and often called [[Lady Droid|his girlfriend]] using a [[Star*Link]] booth.<ref name="Star Tours" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|A visiting droid making an intergalactic call home.|"Passenger Droid"{{'s}} description in ''Complete Guide to Star Tours''|<ref name="Complete Guide to Star Tours" />}}
F-29-PSKx was created for [[Tokyo Disneyland]]'s [[Wikipedia:Simulator ride|simulator ride]] [[Wikipedia:Amusement park|theme park]] attraction [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']], which opened on [[July 12]], [[1989]]. He, alongside [[F-25-OJSx]], were the only F series droids in the ride to not be identified by name on the "Spot the Droid" posters<ref name="Star Tours" /> or in ''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]'', being instead only identified as "Passenger Droid" and "Spacecap Droid," respectively.<ref name="Complete Guide to Star Tours" />
